name: tabs
title: Animated Tabs
description: A row of four small pill labels, one filled to mark the active tab, above a large rounded gradient card. Clicking a label springs the highlight across and brings that card to the front of a shallow stack.
use: A short set of product areas where each tab deserves a large illustrated panel.
avoid: Content needs a set height: the absolutely stacked panels collapse without one.
a11y: Tabs are plain buttons without tablist or aria-selected roles, and no focus-visible style is added. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A row of four small pill labels on a black page, one filled grey to mark the active tab, with a wide rounded gradient panel below it holding a bold heading and one line of pale copy. Other panels sit behind the front card, slightly smaller and dimmer.
behaves: Clicking a label springs the grey pill across to it and lifts that card to the front; hovering the row fans the stacked cards upward for a moment. The cards behind scale down and fade.
customise: Pass a tabs array of title, value and content node; four className props tune the container, active pill, tab and content, while stacking offsets stay fixed.
weight: light: Four buttons and a few stacked cards driven by a single layout spring.
